evals.name: setup-phpstan
evals.prompt: Set up PHPStan for my plugin with WordPress and WooCommerce stubs.
evals.expected_output: composer require --dev phpstan/phpstan szepeviktor/phpstan-wordpress. Create phpstan.neon with level:5, paths:[src,includes], bootstrapFiles:[vendor/autoload.php], includes:[vendor/szepeviktor/phpstan-wordpress/extension.neon]. Add phpstan script to composer.json. For WooCommerce: add woocommerce stubs package.

evals.name: fix-undefined-wp-functions
evals.prompt: PHPStan is reporting undefined function errors for WP core functions like get_option and wp_mail.
evals.expected_output: The WordPress stubs package is missing or not included in phpstan.neon. Run composer require --dev szepeviktor/phpstan-wordpress. Add includes:[vendor/szepeviktor/phpstan-wordpress/extension.neon] to phpstan.neon. If still failing, check phpstan version compatibility. Do NOT add @phpstan-ignore-next-line for core WP functions.

evals.name: add-third-party-stubs
evals.prompt: PHPStan can't see Freemius SDK methods — add stubs for it.
evals.expected_output: Check if mralaminahamed/freemius-stubs exists on packagist. If yes: composer require --dev mralaminahamed/freemius-stubs, add scanFiles or scanDirectories to phpstan.neon. If not: scaffold stub file with class Freemius { public function can_use_premium_code(): bool {} ... } and reference in phpstan.neon scanFiles.
